name: skill-scan
description: Shows skill-scan risk signals for agent skills (SKILL.md and bundled scripts) as editor diagnostics, with each rule's reviewer guidance. A rule match is a signal, not a verdict.

commands.title: Skill Scan: Scan the skill of the current file
Skill Scan: Scan every skill in the workspace

skillScan.command.description: The skill-scan command. Install it with `pip install -e .` in the Group 9 repository, or give a full path such as .venv/Scripts/skill-scan.exe.

skillScan.rulesPath.description: Rule file (rules/skill_risk_rules.yaml). Empty uses the command's default.

skillScan.cutoff.description: High-risk severity cutoff. Empty uses the rule file's value (6).

skillScan.runOnSave.description: Scan when a SKILL.md or a script inside a skill folder is saved.

skillScan.runOnOpen.description: Scan when a SKILL.md or a script inside a skill folder is opened.

skillScan.showContext.description: Show context matches (below the cutoff) as information diagnostics.
